title: HS30085: Indian Economy
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NoneCourse ContentsIntroduction and Main Features; Structure of
the Indian economy at the time of independence; Development Strategies from
1951 to 1991: Emergence of Mixed Economy; Economic Planning - Objectives,
Strategies, Policies, Main achievements and setbacks under different five-year
plans; Major Problems with their Dimensions: Poverty, Unemployment, Inequality,
Rural-Urban Disparities, Trade Imbalances, External Debt, Inflation and other
Instabilities, Macro management Policies - Monetary, Fiscal, Trade,
Administrative, etc; Growth of Income and Employment: Rate, Pattern and
Disparities; Economic Reforms since 1991; Contemporary Economic Problems and
Issues; Indiaâs Position in the World Economy.
